fields.Name: T216 - Developer Tools Settings Explorer Scope Switch and Detail
fields.Description: Exercises the user/instance scope-tab switch (OnScopeChange) and the row-selection detail aside - a distinct two-scope data view + master/detail interaction unique to this inspector.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose the Admin app. Open the 'Developer Tools' section, then in its left sub-navigation click 'Settings Explorer'. It opens on the 'User Settings' scope tab showing a table of setting keys with type and value columns (or an empty state). Click the 'Instance Configurations' tab and confirm the table switches to that scope. Click a setting row (in whichever scope has rows) and confirm a detail panel opens on the right showing the full key and value. Success is the scope tabs switching the list AND a row opening its detail aside. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Settings Explorer shows User Settings and Instance Configurations scope tabs, each with a count, and switching tabs changes the displayed settings table (or a valid empty state)
Clicking a setting row opens a detail panel showing the selected key's full value
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
